'''Cynthia B. Phillips''' (born 1973){{r|born}} is an American [[planetary geology|planetary geologist]] who works for [[NASA]] at the [[Jet Propulsion Laboratory]]. A focus of her research has been [[Europa (moon)|Europa]], one of the moons of Jupiter, and she is project staff scientist and project science communications lead for the [[Europa Clipper]] spacecraft mission.{{r|solar}} An expert on processing images from space missions to the planets and their moons, and on the geological processes operating within moons,{{r|seti}} she has studied the effects of asteroid impacts on the surface of Europa,{{r|churn}} and definitions of [[Astrobiology|non-earth-based life]] that could apply on places like Europa that are outside the [[circumstellar habitable zone]].{{r|zone}}

==Education and career==
Phillips went to [[Concord-Carlisle High School]] in [[Concord, Massachusetts]], where she grew up. She was an undergraduate at [[Harvard University]], where she studied astronomy, astrophysics, and physics,{{r|solar}} graduating [[magna cum laude]] with an A.B. in 1995.{{r|biosketch}} She completed a Ph.D. in planetary science at the [[University of Arizona]] in 2000. Her dissertation, ''Voyager and Galileo SSI Views of Volcanic Resurfacing on Io and the Search for Geologic Activity on Europa'', was supervised by [[Alfred McEwen]].{{r|arizona}}

She worked as a researcher at the [[SETI Institute]] for 15 years before joining the Jet Propulsion Laboratory to work on the Europa Clipper mission.{{r|solar}}

==Books==
As well as her research publications, Phillips is a coauthor with Shana Priwer of science popularization books including:
*''101 Things You Didn't Know About Da Vinci: Inventions, Intrigue, and Unpublished Works''{{r|books}}
*''101 Things You Didn't Know About Einstein: Sex, Science, and the Secrets of the Universe''{{r|books}}
*''The Everything Astronomy Book: Discover the Mysteries of the Universe''{{r|books}}
*''The Everything Da Vinci Book: Explore the Life and Times of the Ultimate Renaissance Man''{{r|books}}
*''The Everything Einstein Book: From Matter and Energy to Space and Time, All You Need to Understand the Man and His Theories''{{r|books}}
*''Essential Astronomy: Everything You Need to Understand the Mysteries of Our Universe''
*''Space Exploration for Dummies'',{{r|seti}}
*''Bridges and Spans''
*''Dams and Waterways''
*''Skyscrapers and High Rises''
*''Ancient Monuments''
*''Modern Wonders''
